vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Maintain accurate tray labels and live-plant stock counts.
requirements.zh: 维护准确的育苗盘标签及活植物库存数量。

requirements.en: Prepare approved orders and manage stock-movement records.
requirements.zh: 准备获批订单并管理库存搬运记录。

requirements.en: Follow supplied watering schedules and escalate plant-condition concerns.
requirements.zh: 遵循所提供浇水计划，并上报植物状况问题。

requirements.en: Maintain pot-damage records and support small stock-area improvements.
requirements.zh: 维护花盆损坏记录，并支持小型库存区改进。

requirements.en: Preferred: independently analyse germination and survival rates from complete sowing histories.
requirements.zh: 优先：依据完整播种历史独立分析发芽率及存活率。
